settings.content: Sixty days, and you don't have to justify it. One email to contact@try-rosalia.com and you're refunded inside a day. No form, nothing to ship back, and no photograph of your own face required to prove anything. The alternative is asking you to take one more gamble, and you've taken enough of those this year.

settings.text: That's about eleven dollars a week — less than the tub from the baby aisle that burned.

settings.content: And if you want the plain reason to decide tonight rather than after three more months of reading: the photographs are being taken now. The year he'll look back on is happening now. Being recognizable in it is the least vain thing anyone has wanted this year — and it's the one thing the waiting quietly spends.

The woman whose question I answered a moment ago never got a reply. She's two years past it now, and whatever happened to her face happened without anyone explaining a word of this to her. You've just had the reply she was owed. It took a few minutes and cost nothing.

If tonight the honest thing is that you haven't slept properly in three days and can't take on one more decision — that isn't avoidance, and I won't pretend it is. One woman in the corpus decided to do nothing drastic to her face until she'd had a decent night's sleep, and of all of them she was the most sensible. Sleep first. Then decide with the list in your hand — because the weeks in between aren't neutral. They're the ones your face spends either healing, or learning to flush more easily.

settings.text: Whether you buy a bottle is a much smaller question than the one you typed at three in the morning — and you have that answer now, either way.
